style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: the hundred grids are milk chocolate, so chocolate keys with the berry Enter; the golden ribbon bar sits comfortably beside them.

images.why: Look: 'a hundred grid' of 300 by 300, and a second grid of the same size on the second phase; the whole that one hundred equal cells come from, and the one cell lifted out and cut in half ('a tiny half cell sitting alone in a whole grid'). The chapter's grid picture (C5, C15). A hundred cells are past the 40 skins a screen, so the one piece is drawn over each grid and the equal cells are the tool's own lines over it.
images.prompt: One single square of milk chocolate with a softly bevelled rim, a warm brown with a lighter edge and a gentle satin sheen, perfectly plain on top.

images.why: Look: 'a bar under it at the left', 600 long and 50 tall, whose shaded length 'has not moved' while the terms shrink; a bar model of one whole length, so a satin ribbon for a length (IMAGES section 3). Golden so the blue and green tints read on it.
images.prompt: A long straight length of pale golden-yellow satin ribbon with fine woven edges and a smooth, soft sheen that glows gently along its length, the same light buttery gold from end to end.
